description: Staff-maintained text and Markdown files (menus, price lists, policies, FAQs) the agent can list, search and read.
migration_note: Compiled Rust adapter storing text files in the agent plane. Staff (owner or member) save and delete; any permitted session reads. No binary/PDF extraction or automatic recall yet. Deployment requires rebuilding both API and loop.
skill_summary: Search and read the agent's staff-maintained knowledge files; staff can save or delete them.
